summary: The recalled snowmobile's drive clutch can break, allowing fragments to escape the snowmobile shielding, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 16,200.

title: Children's Dressers Sold Exclusively at Rooms To Go Recalled Due to Tip-Over and Entrapment Hazards; Violation of Federal Regulation for Clothing Storage Units; Imported by LFN Limited
summary: The recalled dressers are unstable if they are not properly anchored to the wall, posing serious tip-over and entrapment hazards that can result in injuries or death to children. The dressers violate the performance requirements of the STURDY Act. Units: About 200.

title: Dixon Ticonderoga Recalls Creativity Street Foam Pattern Rollers Due to Violation of Federal Lead Content Ban
summary: The recalled foam pattern rollers are intended for children and contain levels of lead that exceed the federal lead content ban in the rollers' handles. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 2,880 (In addition, 24 in Canada).

title: DR Power Equipment Recalls Leaf Blowers and Leaf Vacuums Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: Pieces from the recalled leaf blowers and vacuums can come loose inside the unit and be ejected, posing a laceration hazard to users and bystanders. Units: About 57,200 (In addition, about 956 were sold in Canada).

title: Igloo Products Recalls Youth Sipper Bottles Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The silicone cover on the sipper can detach while in use, posing a choking hazard to children. Units: About 31,500.

title: Polaris Recalls Prostar S4 Titan Adventure Snowmobiles Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The snowmobile can leak fuel at the pump flange assembly, posing a fire hazard and risk of serious injury to the rider or passenger. Units: About 240 (In addition, about 290 were sold in Canada).

title: Skims Body Recalls SKIMS Children's Pajama Sets Due to Burn Hazard; Violation of Federal Regulations for Children's Sleepwear; Sold Exclusively by Skims Body
summary: The children's pajama sets fail to meet the flammability regulations for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 1,200 (In addition, 23 were sold in Canada).

title: True Manufacturing Recalls Commercial Refrigerators with Secop Compressors Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The recalled commercial refrigerators with Secop Compressors can fail in a manner causing the compressor to overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 29,200 (In addition, about 50 were sold in Mexico).

title: CHZHVAN Combination Smoke and Carbon Monoxide Detectors Recalled Due to Failure to Alert to Fire; Sold Exclusively on Amazon.com by Haikouhuidishangmaoyouxiangongsi
summary: The detectors can fail to activate, posing a risk that consumers will not be alerted to a fire. Units: About 6,800.

summary: Depending on the model, the surface heating elements can: 1) turn on spontaneously without being switched on; 2) fail to turn off after being switched off; or 3) heat to different temperatures than selected. title: Children's Nightgowns Recalled Due to Burn Hazard and Violation of Federal Flammability Standards; Sold Exclusively on Amazon.com; Imported by Zegoo Home
summary: The children's nightgowns violate the flammability standards for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 14,000.

title: Children's Robes Recall Expansion Announced Due to Burn Hazard and Violation of Federal Flammability Standards; Imported by SIORO; Sold Exclusively on Amazon.com; Additional Units Added
summary: The children's robes violate the flammability standards for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 5,000 (About 950 children's robes were previously recalled in June 2021).

title: Cotton On USA Recalls Toy Pinwheels Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The pinwheel's fastener cap can come loose and detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 8,500.

title: Korimefa Multi-Purpose Helmets Recalled Due to Risk of Head Injury; Violation of Federal Regulations for Bicycle Helmets; Imported by Yangxi and Sold Exclusively on Amazon.com
summary: The recalled helmets do not comply with the positional stability requirements of the CPSC federal safety standard for bicycle helmets. The helmets can fail to protect in the event of a crash, posing a risk of head injury. Units: About 60.

title: Spin Swivel Chairs Recalled Due to Fall Hazard; Imported by Article
summary: The swivel chair's base can break, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 4,500 (In addition, about 140 were sold in Canada).

title: Textron Specialized Vehicles Recalls Arctic Cat Model Year 2024 Catalyst Snowmobiles Due to Crash Hazard
summary: The steering caps, which are used to hold the handlebar in place, can crack and cause the handlebars to become unstable, posing a crash hazard. Units: About 2,670 (In addition, about 891 were sold in Canada).

title: Textron Specialized Vehicles Recalls Prowler Pro and Tracker Utility Vehicles (UTVs) Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The fuel tank cap does not fit correctly, causing a fuel leak around the filler neck, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 10,300 (In addition, about 1,000 were sold in Canada).

title: ZLINE Recalls Built-In Electric Wall Ovens Due to Impact Injury Hazard
summary: The oven door hinge can dislodge, releasing the spring, which can damage or break through the door trim, posing an impact injury hazard to consumers. Units: About 5,000.

title: Black & Decker Recalls CRAFTSMAN V20 Cordless Tillers/Cultivators Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The assembly instructions can cause consumers to incorrectly attach the bottom portion of the tiller/cultivator upside down, causing the tines to rotate toward the user, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 44,400.

title: Compare Brands Recalls ADIOS! Super Vinegar All Natural Cleaner Due to Risk of Poisoning and Chemical Burns; Violation of Labeling Requirements under the Federal Hazardous Substances Act; Sold Exclusively on Amazon.com
summary: The recalled cleaning product violates the Federal Hazardous Substances Act because it is deceptively labeled as "Safe to Use" and lacks the required cautionary statements for a poison, posing a risk of poisoning and chemical burns to consumers. Units: About 2,420.

title: Crib Bumpers Recalled Due to Suffocation Hazard; Violation of Federal Crib Bumper Ban; Sold by Henan Ouchang Trading and Xinxiang Junshun Trading on AliExpress and Recalled by AliExpress
summary: Infants can suffocate if they roll or move on the crib bumper in a position that obstructs breathing. Padded crib bumpers are banned under federal law. Units: About 75.

title: Medline Industries Recalls 1.5 Million Adult Portable Bed Rails Due to Serious Entrapment and Asphyxia Hazards; Two Deaths Reported
summary: When the recalled bed rails are attached to an adult's bed, users can become entrapped within the bed rail or between the bed rail and the side of the mattress. title: TOPINCN Pool Drain Covers Recalled Due to Entrapment Hazard; Violation of the Virginia Graeme Baker Pool and Spa Safety Act; Sold Exclusively on Amazon.com by Sanure
summary: The recalled drain covers do not conform to the entrapment protection standards of the Virginia Graeme Baker Pool and Spa Safety Act (VGBA), posing an entrapment hazard to swimmers and bathers. Units: About 340.
